name: router_health
title: health
description: Report whether the task store is readable/writable and the service reachable. Says nothing about backend availability.

name: router_capabilities
title: capabilities
description: List backends/modes with availability, features, permission modes, fallback triggers, and service limits.

name: router_task_prepare
title: task prepare
description: Create a PREPARED task with a frozen assignment and policy. Never creates a backend session or sends input.

name: router_task_lookup
title: task lookup
description: Find a task by clientId + clientTaskId (recovery path when a prepare reply was lost).

name: router_task_start
title: task start
description: Start a PREPARED task under a short-lived authorization. Accepted means durable intent, not backend success.

name: router_events_read
title: events read
description: Read committed task events after a cursor; optional long poll up to 20 s. Never consumes or changes the task.

name: router_task_result
title: task result
description: Read the current result: turns, attempts, evidence and cleanup. businessAcceptance is always not_evaluated.

name: router_turn_text_read
title: turn text read
description: Read a turn's immutable final text by UTF-8 byte offsets.

name: router_permission_reply
title: permission reply
description: Answer one pending permission request for the exact task, turn and owner (allow_once or deny_once).

name: router_task_seal
title: task seal
description: Forbid any further input or dispatch for this task. Does not interrupt an accepted turn.

name: router_task_close
title: task close
description: Close a QUIESCENT task: release only its exact owner, without sending any prompt.

name: router_task_cancel
title: task cancel
description: Record cancellation intent, interrupt the exact owner and finalize. Accepted is not completion; wait for CLOSED.

name: router_task_add_turn
title: task add turn
description: Future capability (same-primary multi-turn). Returns UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY in this version.

name: router_task_authorize
title: task authorize
description: Allow or deny the pending fallback transition request with a fresh grant. Does not select a backend.
